body: Yahoo Sports reported that Allegri was enraged after the 3-3 draw, stating, 'Maybe I shouldn't be on the touchline,' while also noting Roma's comeback. ESPN Singapore's Burley expressed uncertainty, finding it 'hard to tell if Man United were good or Roma were bad.' Conversely, Gasperini offered mixed signals; he warned goal-crazed Roma over the Red Devils but later told Football Italia that 'Numbers count, Roma are scoring a lot of goals,' while admitting to Soccer News that the team 'feel[s] like they dropped two points' in the Napoli draw.
headline: Mixed reactions: Allegri furious, Gasperini cautious on Roma's performance.
